gaps.requirement: A visitor is told plainly what to cite for LabConstrictor itself: the recommended paper first, the software archive separately.
gaps.current: Nowhere on any page body. The only affordance is the unexplained footer link 'Cite LabConstrictor' (overrides/main.html:100), which goes to the Zenodo software record 10.5281/zenodo.20758747 (v0.0.2, 19 June 2026, the latest version of concept 10.5281/zenodo.19074199). The template README recommends the arXiv preprint. The template is at 0.1.15 with no release tags. data/site.yaml:15 `citation_doi` is dead config that duplicates the footer's hard-coded URL.
gaps.proposal: Add a short 'Cite LabConstrictor' section with id `cite` on the home page (after 'Works where you work'). It gives (a) the preprint as the reference to cite when using or discussing LabConstrictor, reusing the README's wording: the 5 authors as printed on arXiv, the title, 'arXiv preprint 2026', DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2603.10704, linked; and (b) one line for the archived software: 'Software archive (Zenodo)', linking the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19074199 for all versions and naming 0.0.2 for the version record. Replace `links.citation_doi` with a `citation:` block in data/site.yaml that is actually rendered (new function in pages_site.py), and point the footer link to the `#cite` anchor, so the DOI is written once on the site. Add the pattern to DESIGN.md first, plus a test that the home page contains the preprint DOI and a test for the failure case (missing key stops the build). Optionally have build_site compare the DOI with the one in the template README so the two cannot drift.
gaps.needs_author_decision: Authors confirm the preprint stays the recommended citation (README says so; no journal version exists per arXiv). Authors choose which Zenodo DOI to show: the concept DOI (all versions) or the 0.0.2 version DOI. The archived version number does not match any tag or the template_version 0.1.15. Authors confirm the exact reference wording (the DataCite record spells the second author 'Pineda, Marcela Xiomara Rivera', the paper 'Marcela Xiomara Rivera Pineda').
gaps.rule_conflicts: Nothing-written-twice: the reference already lives in the template README and the Zenodo record. The template is copied into every app, so it cannot carry site metadata. The precedent is the template card written inline in data/ecosystem.yaml, so data/site.yaml (listed as hand-written in AGENTS.md) is acceptable, ideally with a build-time check against the README DOI. DESIGN.md requires the new pattern to be documented first. The footer link must target an existing anchor, which check_site.py verifies. Do not use any wording not in the README or on arXiv.

gaps.requirement: Every app page has a 'How to cite' block near 'Using it', with an explicit statement when no publication is listed.
gaps.current: Cite is one row in Details (pages_apps.py:152), after Get it, Using it, All downloads and How to install (about 81-84% down the page). It is a bare 'doi:...' link, present on 2 of 6 pages. The VLab4Mic page is silent although its README gives a bioRxiv preprint (10.64898/2026.06.02.729521, verified). Guess the Condition, Demo and Playground say nothing. The schema describes `doi` as 'paper or archive', which conflates the two.
gaps.proposal: Step 1 (small): in pages_apps.py add `cite_section(app)` and call it right after `using_section` in `page_app` (before `downloads_table`). Remove the Cite row from `details_list`. The block shows the DOI link and the app version from the release ('Version used: v0.1.1'). When the manifest has no doi it states 'No publication is listed in this app's manifest.' and links to the LabConstrictor citation block from G1, for citing the packaging. Change the schema description of `doi` to 'DOI of the paper to cite'. In CellMigrationLab/LabConstrictor-VLab4Mic add `doi: 10.64898/2026.06.02.729521` to labconstrictor-app.yaml. Step 2 (medium): resolve title, authors, venue and year from the DOI in scripts/fetch_catalogue.py (Crossref returned HTTP 200 for the NucleiSky, CellTracksColab and VLab4Mic DOIs, DataCite for the arXiv DOI), store them in the snapshot (bump SNAPSHOT_FORMAT) and print the reference with the existing Copy widget (`.lc-code` [data-copy]). Add tests for the present, absent and unresolvable cases.
gaps.needs_author_decision: VLab4Mic owners confirm the preprint is the preferred citation. Guess the Condition, Demo and Playground owners confirm whether any publication exists or whether to cite LabConstrictor. Authors choose plain reference text or BibTeX for the copy button. The site team decides whether a Crossref/DataCite outage stops the fetch (FetchError) or is a per-app problem.
gaps.rule_conflicts: No silent fallbacks: the absent-doi sentence must say what is true ('listed in the manifest'), not assert that no paper exists. Making citation metadata required in the schema would drop apps from the site (AppProblem), so keep `doi` optional. Network access only in fetch_*.py, so DOI resolution goes into the snapshot, not build_site. Resolved bibliographic text is third-party, untrusted input and must pass text.esc. Name forms differ between registries (the arXiv record on DataCite lists 'Pineda, Marcela Xiomara Rivera'). Functions stay at 30 lines or fewer and pages_apps.py is 208 lines, so there is room.

gaps.current: Footer says only 'A project of the Cell Migration Lab' (overrides/main.html:102). There is no page, link, author, institution or funder anywhere. mkdocs.yml:8 `copyright: © Cell Migration Lab` is never rendered. The audit's '(c) Cell Migration Lab' line does not exist on built pages. The preprint does not name the Cell Migration Lab as an affiliation, while cellmig.org lists the preprint.
gaps.proposal: Put one 'Credits' paragraph inside the G1 section (data/site.yaml `citation:`/`credits:`, rendered by pages_site.py): 'Developed by Iván Hidalgo-Cenalmor, Marcela Xiomara Rivera Pineda, Bruno M. Saraiva, Ricardo Henriques and Guillaume Jacquemet (author list of the preprint). Affiliations, contributions and funding are in the preprint.' It links to the arXiv page, so affiliations and funders are not re-typed. Keep the footer line, add 'Credits and citation' to the footer link list pointing to `#cite`, and either delete the unused `copyright:` key from mkdocs.yml or render it in the footer.
gaps.needs_author_decision: Authors approve the wording of the collaboration credit (the 5-author list is supported by arXiv; the preprint's Author contributions support naming I.H.-C. as framework developer only if the authors want that on the site). Whether to name the Cell Migration Lab next to the institutions the preprint lists. Whether to add a funding paragraph at all, and any funder-specific acknowledgement or logo rules (the preprint carries an EU disclaimer; grant communication requirements are not verified here). The InFLAMES numbers in the preprint look mistyped and should be corrected by the authors before any reuse.
gaps.rule_conflicts: Author-controlled exposure: only author-approved text, and no names or roles beyond the preprint. Nothing written twice: link to the preprint for funders instead of copying the acknowledgement. DESIGN.md pattern first.

gaps.requirement: Each app page credits the people who made the app, and the site does not imply that the listing lab owns every app.
gaps.current: The code renders an 'Authors' row (pages_apps.py:148) but 0 of 6 manifests set `authors`, so no app page names anyone. On the VLab4Mic page the only attributions are the GitHub pill 'CellMigrationLab/LabConstrictor-VLab4Mic', the sitewide footer 'A project of the Cell Migration Lab', and a Website pill (vlab4mic.henriqueslab.org). The VLab4Mic preprint's 8 authors (Crossref) do not include anyone from the footer's lab.
gaps.proposal: In each app repo add `authors:` (name, optional ORCID, already in the schema) to labconstrictor-app.yaml: NucleiSky, CellTracksColab and VLab4Mic from their own published author lists, and the other three only as the owners state. In overrides/main.html extend the footer sentence with 'Apps are made and maintained by their own authors.' (or the owners' preferred wording). On the site, nothing else needs to change because the row already exists. Optionally link 'Authors' to the reference in the G2 block.
gaps.needs_author_decision: Who the authors of each app are (software authors need not equal paper authors). For Guess the Condition, Demo and Playground no primary source names anyone, so these stay 'unknown' until the owners say. Preferred wording of the footer note.
gaps.rule_conflicts: Each repo is the source of truth for its own content: authors go in the app manifests, not in a table on the site. App-authored names are untrusted and already pass esc. Do not attribute authorship from the repository owner or the GitHub org.

gaps.requirement: Machine-readable app metadata carries licence, author and citation so that search and citation tools see the same attribution as visitors.
gaps.current: jsonld() (pages_apps.py:176-186) emits name, description, applicationCategory 'ScientificApplication' (also for the Demo and Playground testing apps), url, softwareVersion, operatingSystem. No `license`, `author`, `citation` or identifier, although the manifest provides license for 6/6 apps and doi for 2.
gaps.proposal: In pages_apps.py extend jsonld() with `license` (SPDX URL from app['license']), `citation` as the doi.org URL when the manifest has a doi, and `author` as Person entries only when the manifest has `authors`. Keep the existing <, > and & escaping. Add a test with and without each field.
gaps.rule_conflicts: Untrusted input: only schema-validated fields (SPDX string, DOI pattern, author names) go in, through the existing JSON escaping. Optional fields are checked explicitly, with no defaults. The site is currently noindex (`extra.listed` false), so the value appears at launch.

gaps.requirement: The software-archive citation is traceable to a version, and any future CITATION.cff does not mislead every derived app.

gaps.proposal: Before adding CITATION.cff or .zenodo.json to LabConstrictor, change the initialisation step in LabConstrictor_streamlit (app.py near line 671) to move or replace them as it does README.md, or put them only where they are not inherited. Add CITATION.cff to NucleiSky, CellTracksColab and VLab4Mic using each repo's own README reference.
